#Productivity <- Inbreeding

```{r}
library(sandwich)
library(stargazer)

m1 <- lm(log(Scopus_all + 1) ~ AI, data = inbreeding_at_FEBA)
m2 <- lm(log(Scopus_all + 1) ~ AI + as.numeric(Time_from_phd_to_FEBA)+as.factor(Gender), data = inbreeding_at_FEBA)
m3 <- lm(log(Scopus_all + 1) ~ AI + as.numeric(Time_from_phd_to_FEBA)+as.factor(Gender) + factor(Academic_title),
         data = inbreeding_at_FEBA)
m4 <- lm(log(Scopus_all + 1) ~ AI + as.numeric(Time_from_phd_to_FEBA)+as.factor(Gender) +  + factor(Department),
         data = inbreeding_at_FEBA)
m5 <- lm(log(Scopus_all + 1) ~ AI  +as.numeric(International_collaboration) + as.numeric(Only_national_collab) + as.numeric(Only_institutional_collaboration),
         data = inbreeding_at_FEBA)

# HC3 robust SEs for each model
se_list <- lapply(list(m1, m2, m3, m4, m5), function(m) {
  sqrt(diag(vcovHC(m, type = "HC3")))
})

stargazer(m1, m2, m3, m4, m5,
          se = se_list,
          type = "text",
          keep.stat = c("n", "rsq", "adj.rsq"),
          star.cutoffs = c(0.10, 0.05, 0.01))
```

```{r}
library(AER)
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)
library(stargazer)

d <- inbreeding_at_FEBA

tmp <- trimws(as.character(d$Time_from_phd_to_FEBA))
tmp[tmp %in% c("", "UNKNOWN", "NA", "N/A")] <- NA
d$Time_from_phd_to_FEBA_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(tmp))

cat("Instrument NA count:", sum(is.na(d$Time_from_phd_to_FEBA_num)), "out of", nrow(d), "\n")

# Make sure AI is numeric (0/1) if it came as factor/character
d$AI <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(d$AI)))

# Optional: if these are 0/1 or Yes/No as text, normalize them
to_num01 <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(tolower(as.character(x)))
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))
  out[x %in% c("1","yes","да","true","y","t")] <- 1
  out[x %in% c("0","no","не","false","n","f")] <- 0
  # fallback: try numeric
  num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  out[is.na(out) & !is.na(num)] <- num[is.na(out) & !is.na(num)]
  out
}

d$International_collaboration_num        <- to_num01(d$International_collaboration)
d$Only_national_collab_num               <- to_num01(d$Only_national_collab)
d$Only_institutional_collaboration_num   <- to_num01(d$Only_institutional_collaboration)

iv1 <- ivreg(
  log(Scopus_all + 1) ~ AI |
    Time_from_phd_to_FEBA_num,
  data = d
)

iv2 <- ivreg(
  log(Scopus_all + 1) ~ AI + as.factor(Gender) |
    Time_from_phd_to_FEBA_num + as.factor(Gender),
  data = d
)

iv3 <- ivreg(
  log(Scopus_all + 1) ~ AI + as.factor(Gender) + factor(Academic_title) |
    Time_from_phd_to_FEBA_num + as.factor(Gender) + factor(Academic_title),
  data = d
)

iv4 <- ivreg(
  log(Scopus_all + 1) ~ AI + as.factor(Gender) + factor(Department) |
    Time_from_phd_to_FEBA_num + as.factor(Gender) + factor(Department),
  data = d
)

iv5 <- ivreg(
  log(Scopus_all + 1) ~ AI +
    International_collaboration_num + Only_national_collab_num + Only_institutional_collaboration_num |
    Time_from_phd_to_FEBA_num +
    International_collaboration_num + Only_national_collab_num + Only_institutional_collaboration_num,
  data = d
)

hc3 <- function(m) sqrt(diag(vcovHC(m, type = "HC3")))
se_list_iv <- lapply(list(iv1, iv2, iv3, iv4, iv5), hc3)

stargazer(iv1, iv2, iv3, iv4, iv5,
          se = se_list_iv,
          type = "text",
          keep.stat = c("n", "rsq", "adj.rsq"),
          star.cutoffs = c(0.10, 0.05, 0.01))


summary(iv3, diagnostics = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(sandwich)
library(stargazer)

g1 <- glm(AI ~ log(Scopus_all + 1),
          data = inbreeding_at_FEBA,
          family = binomial(link = "logit"))

g2 <- glm(AI ~ log(Scopus_all + 1)+as.factor(Gender) + ifelse(as.numeric(Time_from_phd_to_FEBA)<365,1,0),
          data = inbreeding_at_FEBA,
          family = binomial(link = "logit"))

g3 <- glm(AI ~ log(Scopus_all + 1)+as.factor(Gender) + ifelse(as.numeric(Time_from_phd_to_FEBA)<365,1,0) + as.factor(Academic_title),
          data = inbreeding_at_FEBA,
          family = binomial(link = "logit"))

g4 <- glm(AI ~ log(Scopus_all + 1) +as.factor(Gender)+ ifelse(as.numeric(Time_from_phd_to_FEBA)<365,1,0) + as.factor(Department),
          data = inbreeding_at_FEBA,
          family = binomial(link = "logit"))

g5 <- glm(AI ~ log(Scopus_all + 1)+as.factor(Gender) + ifelse(as.numeric(Time_from_phd_to_FEBA)<365,1,0) + + as.numeric(International_collaboration) + as.numeric(Only_national_collab) + as.numeric(Only_institutional_collaboration),
          data = inbreeding_at_FEBA,
          family = binomial(link = "logit"))


stargazer(g1, g2, g3, g4, g5,
          type = "text",
          keep.stat = c("n"),
          star.cutoffs = c(0.10, 0.05, 0.01),
          dep.var.labels = "Probability(Inbred hire)",
          omit.stat = c("ll","aic","bic"))
```

```{r}
library(broom)

df <- tidy(g_margins) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(
    term = recode(term,
      "log(Scopus_all + 1)" = "Research productivity",
      "ifelse(as.numeric(Time_from_phd_to_FEBA) < 365, 1, 0)" = "Hired within 1 year of PhD",
      "as.factor(Gender)1" = "Male",

      # Departments
      "as.factor(Department)Econometrics and statistics" = "Department: Econometrics and Statistics",
      "as.factor(Department)Economics" = "Department: Economics",
      "as.factor(Department)ESG" = "Department: ESG",
      "as.factor(Department)FA" = "Department: Finance and Accounting",

      # Academic titles
      "as.factor(Academic_title)Гл. ас." = "Chief assistant",
      "as.factor(Academic_title)Доц." = "Associate professor",
      "as.factor(Academic_title)Проф." = "Professor",

      # FIX THESE THREE
      "as.numeric(Only_institutional_collaboration)" = "Only institutional collaboration",
      "as.numeric(Only_national_collab)" = "Only national collaboration",
      "as.numeric(International_collaboration)" = "International collaboration"
    ),
    low = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
    high = estimate + 1.96 * std.error
  )

ggplot(df, aes(x = estimate, y = reorder(term, estimate))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = low, xmax = high), height = 0.15) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Factors associated with inbred hiring",
    x = "Coefficient",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
packs <- c("marginaleffects","ggplot2")
newpacks <- packs[!(packs %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"])]
if(length(newpacks)) install.packages(newpacks)

library(marginaleffects)
library(ggplot2)

# helper to extract the fast-hire effect
get_fast <- function(model, name){
  mfx <- avg_slopes(model)
  out <- mfx[grep("Time_from_phd_to_FEBA", mfx$term), ]
  if(nrow(out)==0) return(NULL)
  out$model <- name
  return(out)
}

plotdata <- rbind(
  get_fast(g1,"Model 1"),
  get_fast(g2,"Model 2"),
  get_fast(g3,"Model 3"),
  get_fast(g4,"Model 4"),
  get_fast(g5,"Model 5")
)

# clean model ordering
plotdata$model <- factor(plotdata$model,
                         levels=c("Model 1","Model 2","Model 3","Model 4","Model 5"))


## Plot
############################################################

ggplot(plotdata, aes(x=model, y=estimate)) +
  geom_point(size=3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=.12) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dashed") +
  labs(
    y="Marginal effect on Pr(Inbred hire)",
    x="Specification",
    title="Effect of Immediate Hiring (within 1 year after PhD or less)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```

#Interactions

```{r}

# Packages
packs <- c("sandwich","stargazer")
newpacks <- packs[!(packs %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"])]
if(length(newpacks)) install.packages(newpacks)

library(sandwich)
library(stargazer)

# --- (Optional but recommended) quick type clean ---
to_num <- function(x) {
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(x)
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub(",", ".", x, fixed = TRUE)
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

inbreeding_at_FEBA$Scopus_all <- to_num(inbreeding_at_FEBA$Scopus_all)
inbreeding_at_FEBA$Time_from_phd_to_FEBA <- to_num(inbreeding_at_FEBA$Time_from_phd_to_FEBA)
inbreeding_at_FEBA$AI <- to_num(inbreeding_at_FEBA$AI)
inbreeding_at_FEBA$International_collaboration <- to_num(inbreeding_at_FEBA$International_collaboration)
inbreeding_at_FEBA$Only_national_collab <- to_num(inbreeding_at_FEBA$Only_national_collab)
inbreeding_at_FEBA$Only_institutional_collaboration <- to_num(inbreeding_at_FEBA$Only_institutional_collaboration)

# --- Robust SEs that ALWAYS align with coefficients (fixes missing SE rows) ---
robust_se_HC3 <- function(m){
  cn <- names(coef(m))
  V  <- vcovHC(m, type = "HC3")
  se <- rep(NA_real_, length(cn))
  names(se) <- cn
  common <- intersect(cn, colnames(V))
  se[common] <- sqrt(diag(V))[common]
  se
}

# --- Baseline model (your m5) ---
m5 <- lm(log(Scopus_all + 1) ~ AI + ifelse(as.numeric(Time_from_phd_to_FEBA)<365,1,0) +
           factor(Academic_title) + factor(Department) ,
         data = inbreeding_at_FEBA)

# --- Interactions ---
# AI × Title
m6_rank <- lm(log(Scopus_all + 1) ~ AI * factor(Academic_title) + ifelse(as.numeric(Time_from_phd_to_FEBA)<365,1,0) +
                factor(Department) ,
              data = inbreeding_at_FEBA)

# AI × International collaboration
m7_net <- lm(log(Scopus_all + 1) ~ AI * International_collaboration + ifelse(as.numeric(Time_from_phd_to_FEBA)<365,1,0) +
               factor(Academic_title) + factor(Department) ,
             data = inbreeding_at_FEBA)

# AI × Department
m8_dept <- lm(log(Scopus_all + 1) ~ AI * factor(Department) + ifelse(as.numeric(Time_from_phd_to_FEBA)<365,1,0) +
                factor(Academic_title) +
                International_collaboration ,
              data = inbreeding_at_FEBA)

# --- Robust SE lists ---
models  <- list(m5, m6_rank, m7_net, m8_dept)
se_list <- lapply(models, robust_se_HC3)

# --- Output table ---
stargazer(models,
          type = "text",
          column.labels = c("Baseline", "AI×Title", "AI×IntlCollab", "AI×Dept"),
          dep.var.labels = "log(Scopus + 1)",
          keep.stat = c("n", "rsq", "adj.rsq"),
          star.cutoffs = c(0.10, 0.05, 0.01),
          omit.stat = c("f","ser"))
```

#time from first employment to PHD

```{r}
## Economist-style "dumbbell timeline":
## PhD award (black hollow) vs first FEBA employment (red filled)


packs <- c("dplyr","tidyr","ggplot2","lubridate","scales")
newpacks <- packs[!(packs %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"])]
if(length(newpacks)) install.packages(newpacks)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(scales)

# --- robust date parser for Excel / strings ---
parse_date_safe <- function(x){
  if (inherits(x, "Date")) return(x)
  if (inherits(x, "POSIXct") || inherits(x, "POSIXt")) return(as.Date(x))
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(as.Date(x, origin = "1899-12-30"))  # Excel serials
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x[x == "" | x %in% c("NA","N/A","na")] <- NA
  d <- suppressWarnings(as.Date(x))
  if (all(is.na(d))) {
    d <- suppressWarnings(parse_date_time(x, orders = c(
      "Y-m-d","d-m-Y","d/m/Y","m/d/Y","Y/m/d","d.b.Y","d.b.y","d.m.Y","d.m.y"
    )))
    return(as.Date(d))
  }
  d
}

# --- build plotting frame ---
df <- inbreeding_at_FEBA %>%
  transmute(
    phd  = parse_date_safe(PHD_Awarded),
    hire = parse_date_safe(FIRST_PT_FEBA)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(phd), !is.na(hire)) %>%
  mutate(
    gap_days = as.numeric(hire - phd),
    gap_years = gap_days / 365.25
  )

# order rows like the example: by hire date (or by gap; choose one)
df <- df %>%
  arrange(hire, phd) %>%
  mutate(person = row_number())  # anonymous index, like the screenshot

# --- plot ---
p <- ggplot(df, aes(y = reorder(factor(person), hire))) +
  # connecting line
  geom_segment(aes(x = phd, xend = hire, yend = reorder(factor(person), hire)),
               linewidth = 0.7, color = "grey80") +
  # phd point (black hollow)
  geom_point(aes(x = phd), shape = 21, size = 3.0,
             stroke = 1.0, fill = "white", color = "black") +
  # hire point (red filled)
  geom_point(aes(x = hire), shape = 16, size = 2.6, color = "red3") +
  # a clean x-axis with years
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "4 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
  labs(
    title = "First academic employment vs PhD award at FEBA",
    subtitle = "Hire date in red (filled); PhD award in black (hollow)",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey30"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "grey20"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 15, 10, 10)
  )

print(p)
```
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

parse_date_safe <- function(x){
  if (inherits(x, "Date")) return(x)
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(as.Date(x, origin="1899-12-30"))
  suppressWarnings(as.Date(x))
}

df <- inbreeding_at_FEBA %>%
  mutate(
    phd  = parse_date_safe(PHD_Awarded),
    hire = parse_date_safe(FIRST_PT_FEBA),
    delay_days  = as.numeric(phd-hire),
    delay_years = delay_days / 365.25,
    phd_year = year(phd)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(delay_days))

df$post2010 <- ifelse(df$phd_year >= 2010, 1, 0)
t.test(delay_years ~ post2010, data=df)
m_delay <- lm(delay_years ~ post2010, data=df)
summary(m_delay)
m_delay2 <- lm(delay_years ~ post2010 + factor(Department) + factor(Academic_title)+factor(Gender),
               data=df)
summary(m_delay2)
install.packages("survival")
library(survival)
cox <- coxph(
  Surv(delay_days) ~ post2010 + factor(Department),
  data = df
)
summary(cox)
```
